# Renderer dependencies

- three.js r160 and its loaders/controls: MIT, `LICENSE.three`.
- mp4-muxer 5.1.5: MIT, `LICENSE.mp4-muxer`, retrieved from the exact package
  at https://registry.npmjs.org/mp4-muxer/5.1.5. Its vendored build matches the
  package bytes: SHA256 `69f25ab5dd735289936fedbf72a0430182f6c053a0cc6b555beefb810d3d2ca9`.

The HTML templates carry both license notices so exported, shareable pages
retain the notices alongside their embedded JavaScript.
